coder-brief-slice-four-mixed-batches.text: Coder brief, slice four: mixed batches.

The whole of slice four for the commit owner, with its terminal condition. The binding, the rulings and the limits are in the mandate; the call surface is in the functions model; the batch semantics are in the evidence contract; the proof is the gate. Slices one and two are on the branch; slice three is independent of this one.

story.text: As a processor building one batch, I fold Bob's insertion of a fresh key and reject Carol's insertion of the same key in the same batch, and the model accepts the batch because Carol's request is judged on the state Bob's fold left; with Carol's request first the model refuses, because at that point her request is still foldable.

seat.text: You are not alone in the codebase; do not revert edits made by others. No Co-Authored-By, no attribution. Plain words, no coined abbreviations.

the-task.text: Port the earlier attempt's ordered batch design as the functions model states it.

Failing control first: add the two corpus scenarios above (fold then reject accepted; reject then fold refused) and an empty batch refused; they fail on the branch as it stands because the question does not exist. Keep that output as the RED bundle.
Add the action type, the one-action and ordered-action functions (the engine) and the mixed-batch function with its three refusals (empty batch, empty interval, net-mint mismatch).
Move the all-reject batch onto the engine and delete slice two's own loop in the same change, so one admission path remains.

State and prove the slice-four statements: a rejection in an accepted batch passed admission on the prefix state; a foldable request cannot be rejected at any position; an empty batch is refused; the all-reject batch runs exactly the engine.

Add the driver's mixed-batch question to the declared batch questions, its serialization and corpus rows, and the transport support; re-pin the surface digest. No live row is added: no mixed transaction is built here, so a live mixed batch is published uncovered.
Regenerate every copy the change moves, extend the restatement table, add the mixed-batch row to the constitution and complete the 1.15.0 entry.

checkpoints.text: Journal REVIEW-REQUESTED with commit and evidence path, and continue, at: the RED bundle; the engine and statements green; the question, corpus and transport green; the final head.

gate.text: The slice-four rows of the gate, once per candidate on a clean committed tree. No devnet.

terminal-condition.text: Stop at the first of: every slice-four gate command exits as the gate states on a clean committed head (CANDIDATE-GREEN); a question the mandate cannot decide (user story per option, BLOCKED); capacity (COMPLETE capacity-limit with a handoff). Touch nothing under the files this ticket must not touch.
